definitions.gloss: postponement; rescheduling to a later date
definitions.explanation: Pushing an event to the next available date, typically the following day. Most commonly used for outdoor events postponed due to weather. Unlike general postponement, {順延|じゅんえん} implies moving to the next sequential date rather than an indefinite delay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨天|うてん}→雨天：15325_uten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{順延|じゅんえん}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In case of rain, the event will be postponed to the next day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{順延|じゅんえん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The sports day was postponed due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{順延|じゅんえん}になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{使|つか}えます→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Since the game was postponed, the tickets can be used as-is the next day.

notes:
USAGE: {順延|じゅんえん} specifically means postponing to the next available date in sequence, not rescheduling to an arbitrary future date. It is extremely common in announcements for outdoor events like sports days, festivals, and baseball games.

The phrase ⟦{雨天|うてん}→雨天：15325_uten⟧{順延|じゅんえん} ("postponed in case of rain") is a fixed expression seen on event flyers and posters throughout Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雨天|うてん}→雨天：15325_uten⟧{順延|じゅんえん}: postponed if it rains
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{順延|じゅんえん}: postponed by one day
- {順延|じゅんえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be postponed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {順延|じゅんえん}: postponement to the next sequential date
- ⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧: general postponement (may be to any future date)
- ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧: cancellation (event does not take place at all)
